result.description:
About us

I.J. Projects is a family-founded building and project management company with over 50 years of industry experience, delivering high-quality building, civil construction and project management services across South Australia. The company specialises in managing commercial, government and infrastructure projects from planning through to successful completion and has established a strong reputation for quality, safety and client satisfaction


About the role

As our business continues to expand, we are seeking an experienced Sales and Marketing Manager to lead the company's sales, business development and marketing functions. This is a newly established full-time permanent management position reporting directly to senior management and will play a key role in driving business growth, strengthening the company's market presence, and developing long-term relationships with government, commercial and institutional clients


Key responsibilities:

- Develop and implement the company's sales and marketing strategies to achieve sustainable business growth and increase market share.
- Identify new business opportunities, analyse market trends and competitor activities, and develop strategic growth initiatives.
- Lead the company's business development activities by establishing and maintaining relationships with government agencies, developers, consultants, contractors and key industry stakeholders.
- Oversee the preparation of marketing strategies, promotional campaigns and brand positioning to enhance the company's profile within the construction and project management sectors.
- Direct the development and implementation of client relationship management strategies to strengthen customer retention and generate repeat business.
- Work closely with senior management to identify and pursue major project opportunities, including government and private sector procurement and tender opportunities.
- Prepare sales forecasts, marketing budgets, business performance reports and strategic recommendations for senior management.
- Lead, mentor and manage sales and marketing personnel to achieve business objectives and maintain high performance standards.
- Represent the company at industry events, networking functions and stakeholder meetings to promote the company's services and establish strategic partnerships.


Selection criteria:

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, Marketing, Management, Commerce or a related discipline.
- Demonstrated experience in a senior sales and marketing management role with responsibility for developing and implementing strategic business growth initiatives.
- Proven ability to develop commercial opportunities and build strong relationships with government agencies, commercial clients, developers and key industry stakeholders.
- Strong strategic planning, leadership, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
- Experience preparing sales forecasts, marketing plans and business performance reports.
- Previous experience within the building, construction, engineering or project management industry will be highly regarded; applicants with transferable senior sales and marketing management experience from other industries are also encouraged to apply.

Salary: $130,000 per annum (base), plus superannuation
Location: Adelaide, South Australia
How to apply: Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

Duties and Responsibilities:
As a IT Consultant/Programmer, you will be responsible for analysing, assessing, designing, developing, testing, implementing maintaining and supporting quality applications that supports the company’s key objectives.

Main responsibilities include:
• Writing software code, automated unit tests, and debugging the code to delivery documented working software that meets the requirements in accordance to FedEx secure code practices, policies and established coding standards.
• Translate business requirements and system requirements into detailed technical specifications or business features and user stories using the SAFe Agile framework.
Provide technical mentoring and guidance to other developers.
• Design application solutions that meet complex business requirements, modelling the solution and implement code reviews and other quality management practices across a team of developers.
• Implement software development design patterns to deliver on complex technical requirements to deliver well-engineered working software that is scalable, resilient, maintainable, performant, secure, fault-tolerant, portable, extensible, reusable, testable and easy to use.
• Design and execute complex application testing for functional and non-functional testing including stress and load testing, building test doubles/hubs, test management data, regression testing and complex scenario and use case management.

Analyst and Support Tasks:
• Consultation and analysis of key systems with Stakeholder.
• Collaborating with the enterprise Applications Team and Operations Team around production incidents involving integration to directly or indirectly ensure their timely resolution/recovery and preventative measures are taken to avoid recurrence and minimize business impact
• Maintenance of operational and end-user documentation
• Planning and technical delivery of integration work packages

Experience and Qualifications:
• Minimum 2+ years experience using Java JMS API in a Linux/Unix environment.
• Experience in developing Java applications in Cloud Native environment.
• Experience in building microservices using Spring Core and Spring Cloud.
• Extensive knowledge and experience in using Microservices Architecture Patterns.
• Experience in TDD and BDD practices using Java & Spring based Junit & BDD frameworks.
• Good knowledge and experience in using Kafka for message streaming and for event driven pub/sub notifications.
• Experience in modern networking, IPV4 stack, ICMP, UDP, TCP/IP, socket programming.
• Experience with working with databases e.g. MSSQL, MYSQL, Informix, Oracle.
• Proven ability to lead the development of software development projects.
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems or similar
SAFe Agile certification highly desirable

Data Engineer
Trading under Publicis Communications
Location: Sydney or Melbourne or Brisbane

Data Engineer (also known as BI Developer, Quantitative Data Engineer, Search Engineer, Technical Architect, Big Data Analyst, Solutions Architect, Data Warehouse Engineer, Data Science Software Engineer, ETL Developer)
The role of the Data Engineer is to work alongside solution architects, data analysts & data scientists to deliver various aspects of the marketing technology ecosystem. The Data Engineer is responsible for engaging machine learning techniques to create and sustain structures that allow for the analysis of data whilst remaining familiar with dominant programming and deployment strategies. Data engineering experience is critical, as well as knowledge of data warehousing, ETL strategies and tools, and BI tools. Experience in cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS and GCP is beneficial.
Data Engineer Responsibilities:
•	Anticipating and mitigating delivery risks and following issues through to closure
•	Advocating for data management methodologies and processes on all projects
•	Assuming responsibility for data quality, ensuring that testing is carried out in a rigorous fashion resulting in production of high-quality deliverables
•	Adopting a flexible approach to completing workload to ensuring timely delivery and reinforcing commitment to delivery and quality within the technical team, including offshore development centres 
•	Creating and managing the relevant technical design documentation and ensures the documents completeness and accuracy
•	Ensuring that data architecture is implemented according to the design 
•	Ensuring solutions delivered use existing standards and frameworks
•	Contributing to business development efforts through accurate project scoping, estimating and attending sales calls when required
•	Collaborating with globally dispersed teams on international projects.  This includes co-ordinating build activities with offshore development centres in India and Asia Pacific
•	Remaining up-to-date with industry standards and technological advancements that will improve the quality of your outputs.
Data Engineer Requirements:
•	All of the above roles require a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.
•	Proven experience as a data engineer, software developer, or similar.
•	Expert proficiency in Python, C++, Java, R, and SQL.
•	Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
•	Works well independently but also a team player and able to work collaboratively
•	Scrupulous approach to duties.
•	Strong presentation and written communication skills, with ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical colleagues and clients
•	Experience developing data processing and analytics solutions in a digital agency or IT consultancy as part of a multi-disciplinary team

result.description:
Build the software that protects our most security-conscious organisations.

Most software developers improve products. Here, you'll help redefine them. At Janusnet, our software protects some of Australia's most security-conscious organisations across government, defence and critical infrastructure.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for an experienced Senior C++ / COM Developer to modernise existing products, help shape our next generation of security solutions, and bring entirely new products to market.

If you're looking for a role where your ideas influence product direction not just sprint tickets this is it.

The Perks

    Hybrid working (50/50 between home and our North Sydney office)
    Build new cybersecurity products from the ground up
    Variety across architecture, product development, innovation and emerging technologies
    Job stability and growth 

What You'll Be Doing
You'll play a key role in modernising our existing suite of trusted security solutions while designing and developing new products that respond to evolving customer needs and emerging technologies.

Working across the full software development lifecycle, you'll build secure, high-quality Windows applications using C++ and COM, applying Secure by Design principles to solutions relied upon by government, defence and critical infrastructure organisations.

Along the way, you'll collaborate with talented engineers and cross-functional teams, influence technical direction and product strategy, and contribute to a culture of innovation as we continue to expand and bring new ideas to market.

What We're Looking For:

    Extensive commercial C++ development experience
    Strong Microsoft COM and Windows development
    Experience across the full software development lifecycle Experience building commercial software productsSecure software development experience
    Experience with server and endpoint security products, security frameworks like Secure by Design, NIST or compliance standards DISP or ISM will put you well ahead.

Australian Citizenship is essential, along with the ability to obtain a Baseline Security Clearance.

Why Janusnet?

For more than 20 years, Janusnet has been developing trusted information security solutions used by government, defence and commercial organisations across Australia and around the world.

We're big enough to work on complex, meaningful security challenges, but still small enough that every engineer has genuine influence over the products we build.

Here, you'll have the opportunity to challenge ideas, innovate, and help shape technology that protects organisations where security matters most.

If you're ready to build software that genuinely makes a difference, and want the opportunity to influence products from concept through to release we'd love to hear from you!

For a confidential discussion, connect with Victoria Williams on 03 9691 4712.

Ready chart a new course?

To download the PD, and to apply for this job go to: https://janusnet.recruitmenthub.com.au/Vacancies

## Network Administrator
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and proactive Network Administrator to join our team and play a key role in maintaining the integrity, performance, and security of our organisation's network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience in network administration, a methodical approach to troubleshooting, and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly across all levels of the business. This role suits a detail-oriented professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and is committed to delivering reliable, efficient IT services.
## Key Responsibilities
- Install, configure, and maintain network hardware, software, servers, and workstations, ensuring systems are kept up to date and performing optimally
- Monitor network performance on an ongoing basis, identifying and resolving issues proactively to minimise disruption to business operations
- Diagnose and troubleshoot network faults, emergencies, and connectivity issues, documenting resolutions and maintaining accurate records of all incidents and modifications
- Develop, maintain, and update procedures and documentation for network inventory, configuration changes, and maintenance instructions
- Manage user accounts, access permissions, and password policies in line with the organisation's security standards and compliance requirements
- Provide network programming and scripting support to address specific business needs and improve the efficiency of network operations
- Administer and support servers, printers, and personal computers, ensuring hardware resources remain reliable and fit for purpose
- Evaluate and implement upgrades to network infrastructure, recommending improvements that align with business growth and evolving technology requirements
- Deliver helpdesk support and technical assistance to end users, resolving issues in a timely manner and escalating complex problems where necessary
- Conduct user training and produce clear guidance materials to build internal capability and promote best practice use of network systems
- Maintain network security protocols, including firewall management, intrusion detection, and vulnerability assessments, to safeguard organisational data and systems
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to coordinate service delivery, procurement, and project implementation
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related discipline
- Proven experience in a network administration or systems administration role within a corporate or enterprise environment
- Strong working knowledge of networking protocols, infrastructure components, and technologies including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, LAN/WAN, and firewalls
- Demonstrated experience installing, configuring, and managing servers, switches, routers, and associated network hardware
- Proficiency in network monitoring and diagnostic tools, with the ability to analyse performance data and respond to anomalies
- Solid understanding of network security principles, including access control, patch management, and risk mitigation
- Experience maintaining technical documentation, network inventories, and fault resolution records to a high standard
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work methodically under pressure
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and contribute effectively within a collaborative team environment
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, or equivalent
- Experience with virtualisation platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V
- Familiarity with cloud-based infrastructure and hybrid network environments
- Experience working within ITIL frameworks or other structured IT service management methodologies
- Exposure to scripting or automation tools such as PowerShell, Python, or Ansible to streamline network operations
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a supportive, forward-thinking team that values continuous learning and invests in your professional development through training and certification opportunities
- Enjoy genuine flexibility with a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance
- Work on diverse and challenging infrastructure projects that will broaden your technical expertise and keep your skills at the cutting edge
- Join an organisation with a strong culture of collaboration, where your contributions are recognised and your ideas are encouraged
- Competitive remuneration package with long-term career pathways and opportunities for progression within a growing business
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation

## Network Analyst
## Position Overview
We are looking for an experienced and analytical Network Analyst to join our team and play a key role in maintaining, optimising, and evolving our organisation's network infrastructure. The successful candidate will be responsible for researching and analysing network architecture, recommending strategies for network design and planning, and ensuring systems operate at peak performance. This role suits a detail-oriented professional with a strong technical background who is equally comfortable working on strategic planning as they are on day-to-day network operations. You will collaborate closely with IT teams and stakeholders to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable network solutions across the organisation.
## Key Responsibilities
- Analyse, develop, and evaluate complex network architecture, system design specifications, data models, and diagrams to support the configuration, integration, and ongoing development of computer systems
- Research, monitor, and assess network infrastructure to ensure all systems are correctly configured and consistently operating at optimal performance levels
- Monitor network traffic, activity, capacity, and usage on an ongoing basis to maintain network integrity, identify anomalies, and proactively address performance issues before they escalate
- Identify opportunities for improvement across network operations and recommend enhancements to integrated hardware, software, communications, and operating systems
- Design, plan, and coordinate network architecture strategies that align with the organisation's broader technology goals and operational requirements
- Perform routine and scheduled network maintenance, including software and hardware upgrades, patch management, and system backups to ensure continuity and resilience
- Troubleshoot and resolve network faults, connectivity issues, and performance degradation, providing timely support to internal teams and end users
- Develop and maintain comprehensive network documentation, including topology diagrams, configuration records, and operational procedures
- Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends, providing informed recommendations on tools and solutions that could improve network capability and efficiency
- Collaborate with cross-functional IT teams, vendors, and stakeholders to support infrastructure projects, system integrations, and technology upgrades
- Contribute to the development and enforcement of network policies, standards, and security protocols to safeguard the organisation's data and systems
- Assist in capacity planning and forecasting to ensure the network infrastructure can support current and future organisational demands
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related discipline
- Demonstrated experience in a network analysis, network engineering, or similar IT infrastructure role
- Strong working knowledge of networking protocols, technologies, and concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, BGP, and OSPF
- Proven experience monitoring and managing enterprise network environments using industry-standard tools and platforms
- Solid understanding of network security principles, firewalls, access controls, and best practices
- Experience with network hardware from leading vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, or Palo Alto
- Ability to analyse complex technical data, interpret performance metrics, and translate findings into actionable recommendations
- Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve network issues efficiently under pressure
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work autonomously, and contribute effectively within a team environment
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent vendor-specific credentials
- Experience working within large-scale or enterprise-level network environments
- Familiarity with cloud networking platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud
- Knowledge of network automation tools and scripting languages such as Python or Ansible
- Experience with SD-WAN technologies and software-defined networking concepts
- Exposure to ITIL frameworks or experience working within a managed service provider (MSP) environment
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking technology team that values innovation and continuous improvement
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications and training programmes
- Enjoy a flexible working environment with hybrid arrangements available to support work-life balance
- Competitive remuneration package with clearly defined career progression pathways
- Work on diverse and meaningful infrastructure projects that directly impact the performance and reliability of the wider organisation
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation
